_comment: The D0 calibration grid used for the published results. Passed to
src/calibrate_d0.py with --config; every value here overrides the script's
DEFAULTS, which sweep a wider grid on three seeds and land one grid point
d0_grid is deliberately empty: d0_grid() takes the UNION of the expanded
per-population ranges and the explicit d0_values, so leaving the default
ranges in place would add back the 30-point sweep.
Only keys under 'model' and 'calibration' are read; this key is ignored.
